intelligence.enrichment: Microorganisms can be categorised into groups such as protozoa, fungi, bacteria, and some algae. Viruses are microscopic and acellular, and they multiply when they enter a living cell. Observed or stated features -> microbe category or virus boundary -> correct classification. The learner correctly applies this rule: Microorganisms can be categorised into groups such as protozoa, fungi, bacteria, and some algae. Viruses are microscopic and acellular, and they multiply when they enter a living cell. Anything microscopic is basically a bacterium, so the exact category does not matter.
